fields.options: Build a document number from the Segments below (drag to reorder). Watch the Live Preview update as you go. When several rules match a document, the most specific one wins (Company + Branch + each condition add specificity).

fields.description: Optional — leave blank to apply to every company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Optional — leave blank to apply to every branch.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: This rule applies only when ALL conditions match the document. Pick a field, then choose/type the value it must equal. Leave empty for a default/base rule.
fields.label: Apply only when … (conditions)

fields.description: Optional. The rule applies only when the document's date falls inside this window — useful for cut-over dates (old format before a date, new format after).
fields.label: Applies during … (date window)

fields.description: Rule applies from this date (based on the document's date). Leave blank for no lower bound.
fields.label: Valid From

fields.description: Rule applies up to and including this date. Leave blank for no upper bound.
fields.label: Valid Upto

fields.description: Which date on the document to compare. Leave blank to use Posting/Transaction Date automatically.
fields.label: Date Field

fields.description: The number is built by joining these segments (in order) with the separator. Empty segments are skipped. Include exactly one Number segment.
fields.label: Number Segments

fields.description: Where the generated number is stored on the document.
fields.label: Store Number In
